tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya gar skad du// ārya lo ha kā la dunḍa nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lcags mchu nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'dam bu'i khrod na/ gzings ma'i 'dug gnas na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'dzam bu'i gling gi gnas der 'dong ngo*// btsun pa de ltar bgyi'o zhes gsol nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar mnyan no// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i phyir/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa dang*/ rgya mtsho dang*/ dga' bo dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ gzi can dang*/ e la'i 'dab ma can dang*/ mdongs bu dang*/ klu'i rgyal po glog 'byin dang*/ klu'i rgyal po chu lha dang*/ ku'i rgyal po sprin skul dang*/ klu'i rgyal po mgo bo dgu pa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po mgo bo bdun pa dang*/ mgo bo drug pa dang*/ mgo bo lnga pa dang*/ mgo bo gsum pa dang*/ mgo bo gnyis pa dang*/ mgo bo stong pa rnams la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis man sa bsgag go /a na na te/ bi na na te/ bi shi ki shi/ a gu bi dgu re re/ hūm̐ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ bhan dza ya pra sa shri ra rā ṇi/ ma tri tra ma kra ni na ne na/ bho pa na ge na tra ma te/ badzra dus te/ na mau ra nān/ spa la ya/ ma hā ri ha ra/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ sa ra sa ra/ bi ri bi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ swā hā/ sngags tshan dang pos klu rnams 'khrugs nas brgyal lo/ bcom ldan 'das lo tog dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ sman rnams dang*/ rtsi shing dang*/ myu gu dang*/ 'dab ma dang*/ me tog rnams skam par rngo mi thogs lags so// char dus su 'bebs lags so// rtsi shing dang*/ nags tshal bskyed par bgyid lags so// 'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams kyi longs spyod la 'tshe bar rngo mi thogs lags so// sems can rnams la rnam par 'tshe bar mi bgyid do// gal te bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' las 'das na/

bdag cag rnams kyi lus khums par gyur cig /gnas med par gyur cig /lus rtsub par gyur cig /mdze dang*/ sha bkra 'byung bar gyur cig /mgo bo 'gas pa dang*/ snying 'brul bar gyur cig /ces bro bor ba'o// nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad la gnod pa 'dor ba ste/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par 'dod pa'i 'byung po brgya stong dag kyang sems can rnams kyi phyir 'ongs te/ de dag khyed la gnod pa chen po byed par 'gyur du 'ong gis/ nir gad tsha ta/ nir gad tsha ta/ nir gad tsha ta myur du byer cig /khyed cag las gang dag sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa de dag phung bar gyur cig /gang dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing*/ nyes pa mi 'dod pa/ bsrung bar 'jug pa 'dod pa dag gi ni khyod kyi lus la 'jug par gyur cig /sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis bka' stsal pa/ su mu su mu/ su mu su mu su mu su mu ru su mu ru/ su mu ru su mu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ mi ri mi ri swā hā/ lha rnams dang*/ klu rnams dang*/ lha ma yin rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin pho mo rnams kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i char gyi rgyun myur bar 'bebs so// klu gnas pa'i chu mig kun nas chab phul dgu blangs la/ chab so sor bzhag la yungs kar gyis bsngags shing chu ru bstsal/ sngags rdzogs pa dang klu'i gnas su bskyal lo// char ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'bab par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas 'jig rten la thugs brtse ba can gyis/ sems can rnams la phan pa dgongs par mnga' ba/ byams pa la gnas pa thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dga' ba la gnas pa/ btang snyoms la gnas par gshegs kyis/ kṣi phran nir gad tsha ta swā hā/ nā ga yu yu swā hā/ sprin la blta zhing phyogs bzhir bltas la/ phyag byas shing lan lnga bcur bzlas na/ cha ra myur du nges par 'bebs so// char 'bebs pa'i tshe/ klu mi bsrun pa'i gnas su song la/ lus spos chus bkrus la/ zas dkar gsum 'tshal lo// sha chang sgog btsong spong bar bya'o// byams pa'i sems dang ldan par bsams la/

kha shar phyogs su bltas la 'phags pa rnams la gsol ba gdab bo/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na ma shtsaṇḍa badzra pa ṇa ye/ ma hā yakṣa se nā pa ta ye/ khrom nyi mas sla nān/ glang pa nān ku lu zhi nān/ pi tra pu tra nān/ yakṣa zlog nān/ ri bu ri lu nān/ ba la ya nān/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra badzra dzwa la dzi ha swā hā/ sarba du sha ra/ bi ra nā ga sha swā hā/ ga ru tri ru ti swā hā/ ya thog la bla re sngon po phub/ rgyal mtshan sngon po gzugs/ rig sngags 'chang gdan sngon po/ rkang pa yang sngon por dkri/ lha bshos sngon po/ bum pa chus bkang ba bzhi dkyil 'khor gyi gra bzhir bzhag /dbus su rdo rje snying po dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po dang*/ ku'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang*/ mtha' yas dgod/ shar phyogs kyi padma la klu'i rgyal po mgo bo gsum pa dgod/ lho phyogs kyi padma'i 'dab ma la klu mgo bo bdun pa dgod/ nub phyogs kyi padma la klu mgo bo lnga pa dgod/ byang phyogs kyi padma la klu mgo bo dgu pa dgod/ 'phrin las gzhung las byung ba yang dgod do// oṃ hi hu la phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ bi dza ya phaṭa phaṭa/ nā ga li tsa la/ shad shad/ dzi li ti/ pi pri ti/ badzra dza ya ma hā ba la birya ya par kram/ kro dha rā dza pra me ru phaṭa phaṭa dā/ gzungs 'di brjod ma thag tu/ sa chen po rnams g.yo bar 'gyur ro// klu'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu kha phub tu 'gyel nas/ tshig 'di skad du gsol to// bcom ldan 'das da phyin chad bka' gsungs pa ltar bgyid do// bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ badzra badzra hūṃ hūṃ khrom phaṭa/ ces gsungs pas/ klu'i rgyal po bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu kha phub tu 'gyel nas/ rab tu 'dar te/ brgyal nas 'dre ldog cing ngu'o// de nas klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la smra zhing tshig tu gsol pa/ kye hud bdag cag rnams 'tshig lags so// rdo rje snying po 'bar bas 'tshig lags so// ma rungs lags so// zhes gsol pa dang*/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ klu'i rgyal po rnams 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can la phan pa dang*/ bde ba dang lo legs pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ zhing rnams kyi mig gang bar gyis shig /lo tog phun sum tshogs par sgrubs shig /mi rnams dang*/ mi ma yin pa rnams la 'tshe bar ma byed cig /char gyi rgyun phob cig /'on kyang khyod kyis yun ring po'i bde ba dang*/ phan pa dang*/ klu'i gnod pa kun dang bral bar 'gyur ro// rkang mang khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyi 'ong rnams kyang bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /sangs rgyas lha rnams stong dag gis// khyod la bde legs byed 'gyur pas// sdang sems ldan rnams kun byer cig /snying rje'i bdag nyid can rnams 'khod// gling 'dir char phob 'dod rnams kyis// sa dang bar snang gnas pa rnams// skye dgu rnams la byams byed shog /cha ra med than chen byung ba'i tshe// sngags chen dang po brgya bzlas nas// bar ma lnga bcu lnga bcu bzlas// tha ma lan bdun bzlas par bya// sprin la blta zhing bar bar du// sus kyang ma tshor shub bur bzlas// grangs las thal na ser ba 'grub pas sdig che'o// klu gnad la 'dor ba yin pas sdig che'o// lan grangs yang yang mi dbab bo// zhag gcig gam/ zhag gnyis sam/ zhag lngas char gyi rgyun mi dbab pa mi srid do// chos kyi rgyal po rga shi mi mnga' ba// kun gyi smon lam myur du 'grub par shog /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang*/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang*/ dge slong rnams yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa lcags mchu nag po zhes bya ba'i gzungs than chen rab tu zhi bar byed pa klu rje rigs kyi gnyen po rdzogs so/// /
